item.title: Delayed processing of submitted fingerprints
item.description: As of 13:30 UTC: about 80,000 submissions are still queued, down from 473,000 this morning, and processing is running at around 85,000 per hour. We expect the backlog to clear shortly. Nothing has been lost — submissions are queued and are being processed. Lookups and the website are not affected. Earlier updates: 12:30 UTC — about 143,000 remaining, processing around 55,000 per hour. 11:10 UTC — about 190,000 remaining, processing around 68,000 per hour.
item.content:
